title: Manager: a queue of what needs you, and a key to the next one
notes: Across every open project, oldest first: a pane asking, a card in Review with a PR, an agent quiet 30+ min on a Doing card, a dead pane, a Done card's worktree kept for uncommitted work. Drawn at the top of the manager's general screen. One key from anywhere jumps to the oldest item.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #66: Needs you queue at the top of the manager (asking, died, quiet 30+ min on Doing, Review with no review running, Done with uncommitted worktree), Ctrl+Shift+J to the oldest, jumps split into jumps.ts. v1.7.0.
Shipped in PR #66: the needs-you queue on the manager page and Ctrl+Shift+J to the next item. Two review rounds, all threads fixed.
